message.reasoning_content:
Action phase, round 2. I have 17M cash. Options: produce (free 2 goods), donkey, shuttle, bribe. Produce free gives 2 goods. Bribe 10M for +2 influence? I already have weight 4 of 8; law cards unknown. Influence helps for license bonus and votes. But bribe costs money. Cash devaluation at round 2 boundary: 17M → floor(17/100)... wait cash in units, 17000000 units = 17 alashi. floor(17/100)*62? Actually cash=floor(cash/100)*62 in alashi terms? 17 alashi → floor(17000000/100)*62 = 170000*62 = 10.54M. Hmm heavy devaluation each round. So spending cash now on bribes/goods is good.

Spend on donkeys? Donkey costs 1 alashi gives 1 good; sell price up to ~6 (counter at 6, ladder next: prices index 6 = 5). Marginal. Shuttle: 3 goods, 25% confiscation — expected fine, costs nothing? Shuttle gives 3+subsidy, free action, risk confiscation (cash tribute at favorable border, no border roles here). Confiscation ~25% risk of losing goods; still better than produce's 2 goods free? Shuttle free too. Take shuttle: 3 goods expected 2.25.

Also bribe 10M → +2 influence, boosting votes and possible 5% bank commission. Influence 4 vs others... Max influence gets extra 5% of bank. Bribe 10M (devalues to ~6.2M anyway). But cash needed for round 4 bid (15-25 alashi). I have 17, bidding needs peso. Spend 10 on bribe leaves 7 — too low. Produce is free and safe; but shuttle EV higher. Do shuttle (free, more goods). Only one action allowed. Choose shuttle.
